title: A fragment is displayed
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: CD4 helper T cells can recognize peptides displayed by MHC class II on antigen-presenting cells. Full activation also requires additional signals.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: An antigen-presenting cell displays a peptide on MHC class II. Which T-cell group can recognize that presentation through its receptor? CD4 helper T cells can recognize peptides displayed by MHC class II on antigen-presenting cells. Full activation also requires additional signals.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: Which T-cell group recognizes peptide presented on MHC class II? CD4 T cells can recognize peptide–MHC II complexes.

recall.question: Which T-cell group recognizes peptide presented on MHC class II?
recall.why: CD4 T cells can recognize peptide–MHC II complexes.
